Title: Validate Mandatory Fields
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category=Maintenance, location=Block-A, description=non-empty
Expected Result: Complaint submission accepted and processed.

Title: Validate Mandatory Fields
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category=null, location=Block-A, description=non-empty
Expected Result: Submission rejected with error: category is required.

Title: Validate Mandatory Fields
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category=Maintenance, location=Block-A, description=''
Expected Result: Submission rejected with error: description cannot be empty.

Title: Validate Attachment Specifications
Input/Action: Upload attachment with fileType=pdf and fileSize within limit
Expected Result: Attachment accepted and linked to complaint.

Title: Validate Attachment Specifications
Input/Action: Upload attachment with fileType=exe
Expected Result: Upload rejected with error: file type not allowed.

Title: Validate Attachment Specifications
Input/Action: Upload attachment with fileType=jpg and fileSize exceeding max_size
Expected Result: Upload rejected with error: file size exceeds the allowed limit.

Title: Auto-Assign to Caretaker
Input/Action: Complaint created with category=Electrical, location=Block-B (covered by assignment policy)
Expected Result: Complaint assigned to the caretaker mapped for Electrical/Block-B.

Title: Auto-Assign to Caretaker
Input/Action: Complaint created with category and location not in assignment policy
Expected Result: Complaint flagged as Pending-Assignment and escalated for manual assignment.

Title: SLA Priority Enforcement
Input/Action: Submit complaint with priority=Urgent
Expected Result: SLA deadline set to 24 hours from submission time.

Title: SLA Priority Enforcement
Input/Action: Submit complaint with priority=Standard
Expected Result: SLA deadline set to 3 days from submission time.

Title: SLA Priority Enforcement
Input/Action: Submit complaint with priority=Low
Expected Result: SLA deadline set to 7 days from submission time.

Title: SLA Priority Enforcement
Input/Action: Submit complaint with priority=null or unrecognized value
Expected Result: Submission rejected with error: invalid or missing priority level.

Title: Manual Escalation Justification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/escalate with justification='Issue requires supervisor intervention'
Expected Result: Escalation accepted. Complaint reassigned to Supervisor.

Title: Manual Escalation Justification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/escalate with justification=''
Expected Result: Escalation rejected with error: justification is required.

Title: SLA Breach Escalation
Input/Action: System scheduler detects complaint with status=In Progress and time_since_creation > SLA_timeframe
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Escalated. Supervisor notified automatically.

Title: SLA Breach Escalation
Input/Action: System scheduler checks complaint already in Resolved status with time_since_creation > SLA_timeframe
Expected Result: No escalation triggered. Complaint remains Resolved.

Title: Mandatory Resolution Verification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/verify with action=accept, verifier=Complainant
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Closed.

Title: Mandatory Resolution Verification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/verify with action=accept, verifier=Supervisor
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Closed.

Title: Mandatory Resolution Verification
Input/Action: System attempts to set status=Closed without a verification event
Expected Result: Status change rejected. Complaint remains Resolved pending verification.

Title: Reopening with Justification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/reopen with status=Closed and justification=non-empty
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Reopened. Supervisor notified and complaint reassigned.

Title: Reopening with Justification
Input/Action: POST /complaints/{id}/reopen with justification=''
Expected Result: Reopen request rejected with error: justification is required.

Title: Feedback Prompt on Closure
Input/Action: Complaint status transitions to Closed
Expected Result: System triggers feedback notification to complainant.

Title: Feedback Prompt on Closure
Input/Action: Complaint status transitions to Resolved (not Closed)
Expected Result: No feedback prompt triggered.

Title: Report Generation & Analytics
Input/Action: GET /reports with filters: date_range=last_month, category=Electrical, location=Block-A
Expected Result: Report generated with aggregated complaint data matching the applied filters.

Title: Report Generation & Analytics
Input/Action: GET /reports with no data matching the applied filters
Expected Result: Empty report returned with message: no data available for selected filters.

Title: SLA Reminder Notification
Input/Action: System evaluates complaint where now() + notification_threshold > SLA_deadline
Expected Result: Reminder notification sent to assigned caretaker and supervisor. Event logged.

Title: SLA Reminder Notification
Input/Action: System evaluates complaint where now() + notification_threshold <= SLA_deadline
Expected Result: No reminder sent. Complaint monitored in next scheduled check.

Title: Admin Intervention
Input/Action: Admin with role=Admin accesses complaint with status=Escalated and reassigns it
Expected Result: Complaint reassigned. Intervention logged.

Title: Admin Intervention
Input/Action: Caretaker attempts to access and override an escalated complaint not assigned to them
Expected Result: Action rejected with error: insufficient permissions.

Title: Status Transition Logic
Input/Action: Caretaker updates complaint status from Pending to In Progress
Expected Result: Status transition accepted and logged.

Title: Status Transition Logic
Input/Action: Supervisor updates complaint status from Resolved to Closed after verification
Expected Result: Status transition accepted and logged.

Title: Status Transition Logic
Input/Action: Caretaker attempts to update complaint status from Pending directly to Closed
Expected Result: Transition rejected with error: invalid status transition.

Title: Automated Escalation Routing
Input/Action: Complaint with location=Block-B escalated; escalation_hierarchy maps Block-B to Supervisor-X
Expected Result: Complaint routed to Supervisor-X. Notification sent.

Title: Automated Escalation Routing
Input/Action: Complaint escalated but complaint.location not found in escalation_hierarchy
Expected Result: Escalation routing fails with error. Complaint flagged for manual admin review.

Title: Historical Logging
Input/Action: Complaint status updated from Pending to In Progress by caretaker
Expected Result: Audit log entry created with timestamp, user_id, and action details.

Title: Historical Logging
Input/Action: New complaint submitted by user
Expected Result: Complaint creation event logged with timestamp and user_id.

Title: Historical Logging
Input/Action: Status updated but logging service is unavailable
Expected Result: Update rejected or queued until logging service is restored to ensure audit integrity.
